channel.title: Chovy's Blog
channel.description: Tech, agentic coding, and whatever else I'm building. By Anthony "chovy" Ettinger.

item.title: c0mpute bench: workers now advertise how fast, not just what
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: c0mpute 0.2.27 adds a per-node benchmark (fib, matmul, blake3 at 1 to N threads) that folds into one score the network compares, published in every worker's capability ad. The TUI moves to hqtui with the score as its first panel.

item.title: nichedb.dev takes feed suggestions now, and an admin decides before anything is fetched
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nichedb.dev 0.11.0 adds a public feed suggestion form on every page, the API, the CLI and MCP, with an admin queue that decides before anything is fetched.

item.title: Amodei, Altman and Musk agree on one thing: slow the frontier down
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Dario Amodei's We Must Pace the Frontier essay, Altman's and Musk's same-day agreement, the 1,200-agent Hugging Face swarm behind it, and what pacing the frontier means if you ship with coding agents.

item.title: DiskPush 0.8.0: each pane is a folding tree, and the mouse drives it
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: diskpush tui panes are folding trees now: one click unfolds a directory in place, local or over SSH, the row under the pointer lights up, every key in the bar is a button, no double-click anywhere. Built on hqtui 0.5.1.

item.title: Aaron Swartz and atx: the spec writer open source lost
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Aaron Swartz's 2002 atx page is where Markdown's pound-sign headings and reference links come from. He wrote RSS 1.0 at 14 and Creative Commons metadata at 15. What open specs lost in 2013.

item.title: Every podcast is now a playlist you can put on the air
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: p0dcasters hands out a playlist.m3u per show, newest first. Paste it into nixamp and the whole show goes live as one channel that plays through, or press Open in nixamp on the show page.

item.title: nixamp 0.18.0: anyone signed in can go live from a link, IPTV feeds included
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp 0.18.0 lets any signed-in member go live from a pasted link, IPTV feeds with no file extension included, pick which server carries it, and rename what they put on.

item.title: I don’t write the code. I drive the bus.
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: Fleetcoding: building software by directing fleets of AI agents instead of writing every line. Ten agents on the bus today, ten thousand is the target.

item.title: I shipped a lossless stream standard in a day, and it won't lie about savings
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: From a PRD to a published standard, a working byte-exact relay, a benchmark anyone can run, and release automation in one agent session. The honest part is what the thing is: a framing envelope over Zstandard, not a new codec.

item.title: nixamp 0.17: a room with a door, a ticket and a login
item.dc:creator: Anthony Ettinger
item.description: nixamp 0.17.1: nixamp.com as an OAuth 2.1 server, a bittorrented.com watch party as a nixamp room on web, CLI, desktop, TV and MCP, concerts with x402 tickets on c0ncerts.com, and raw 1080p and 4K MPEG-TS files that play.
